other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh
Applicant must be a widow or a deserted woman
Applicant must be listed among families living Below Poverty Line (BPL)
Applicant must not be receiving pension benefits from any other Central or State Government pension scheme
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of ₹500 per month, directly transferred to their bank account.
